summary: Pairing gateways reject URLs containing usernames or passwords; upgrade all completion members for the origin guarantee.

schema.detail: No claim schema or storage changes.

compatibility.detail: The pair command rejects gateway URLs containing userinfo before making a probe. The completion origin guarantee holds only when every member accepting pairing completion runs this version or later. An older member has no origin check and can still complete a replicated challenge begun on an upgraded member.

manual.detail: Upgrade all members accepting pairing completion. Supply a gateway URL without a username or password.

recovery.detail: Remove URL userinfo and rerun the pair command on the beginning member.
